packing.label: Packing line, 18 and 19 November 2026
packing.def: The camera counted 141 cartons and a person counted 141, over 38 sampled windows on two days the system had never seen. 23 windows matched exactly; the range is about 7% either way.

cartons.label: Dispatch, 12 October 2026
cartons.def: On a day the model had never seen, the camera counted 102 cartons loaded at the dock and a person counting each carton counted 103.

trucks.label: Truck arrivals
trucks.def: The truck-arrival trigger caught every truck arrival in its test. It was trained from about 40 frames.
